containers.name: db
containers.role: Postgres, the lab's own database. On the lab network only, never published.

containers.name: seed
containers.command: lab seed --scenario dev --node edge-hq --user dev --password dev
containers.role: Runs once per lab start: migrates, marks the database as a lab's, seeds the fleet and the login on the first run, and enrolls the node afresh.

containers.name: server
containers.role: The control plane and the console, in lab mode. Its console is the one published port; its bus listens on the lab network for the node.

containers.name: node
containers.role: The edge node edge-hq with the simulator in its own process: the simulated components sit on its loopback, and it collects from them for real. NET_ADMIN, for the impairments, reaches only this container's network.

volumes.name: omniglass-lab_data
volumes.holds: the server's data directory: the lab's own encryption key and the bus's store

walkthroughs.title: Derive a value with a calc rule
walkthroughs.description: Author a calc rule and the metric it writes in one drawer, write the expression that takes each component's slowest TCP connect time, preview and save it, and find the derived value on a component, linked to its rule.

walkthroughs.title: Find a place and fix its label
walkthroughs.description: Drill Explore down to a place, open the system it holds, and rename the place from Configure. The new label follows everywhere the place is read.

walkthroughs.title: Fix a refused probe
walkthroughs.description: A touch panel's SNMP agent refused the endpoint's community, so the node stopped asking. Read why, point the endpoint at the right community, and watch the refusal lift.

walkthroughs.title: Fix a rejected session
walkthroughs.description: A touch panel refused its console login, so the node stopped dialing it. Read why, point the endpoint at the rotated credential, and watch the session come up.

walkthroughs.title: Fix an endpoint in place
walkthroughs.description: Attach the SNMP driver with its host typed one octet short, then correct the host on the endpoint itself and watch samples arrive, with no re-attach.
setup: omniglass component create --label "Bay 2 Display" --location bay-2 --name bay-2-display --product boreal-edge-55

walkthroughs.title: Fix an expression with a quick fix
walkthroughs.description: Write a calc rule's expression with a common mistake, read the plain-words diagnostic the field gives on the spot, apply its one-click fix, and save the rule.

walkthroughs.title: Issue a command and follow it
walkthroughs.description: Tell a video bar its volume from its Activity tab, watch the toast follow the command until the bar's reply settles it, and open the command to read its reply and timing.

walkthroughs.title: Keep data for a week
walkthroughs.description: Shorten how long metric samples are kept, from the default 14 days to 7, on the Settings page, and see the new window take the place of the default.

walkthroughs.title: Preview a notification
walkthroughs.description: Open an operator's notification type, preview it against Touch Panel 2's open alarm, and try a draft subject before saving it.
setup: omniglass component alarm create panel-2 --dedup-key walkthrough-notification --message "No touch input" --severity high

omniglass notification-type create --description "A terse page for the on-call phone" --label "Page on-call" --name page-oncall --subject "{{.SeverityLabel | upper}} {{.ComponentLabel}}" --text "{{.Message}} since {{.RaisedAt}}"

walkthroughs.title: Read a vital two endpoints collect
walkthroughs.description: Open the Boardroom DSP, read which endpoint its TCP connect time comes from and of how many, and open the row for each endpoint's latest value.

walkthroughs.title: Read a simulated component's status
walkthroughs.description: The Simulation page lists every component a simulator serves beside a node. Open one to see where it is served and what has reached it.

walkthroughs.title: Set up monitoring on a component
walkthroughs.description: Attach the SNMP driver and add a reachability probe to a component, both collected by an edge node, and watch reachability and samples arrive.
setup: omniglass component create --label "Bay 2 Display" --location bay-2 --name bay-2-display --product boreal-edge-55

walkthroughs.title: Start a system from a template
walkthroughs.description: Open the template catalog, read what a system template creates, start it at a place, and land on a system that is yours, with nothing pointing back at the template.

walkthroughs.title: Trust a changed host key
walkthroughs.description: A touch panel was reimaged, so it presents a new ssh host key and the node refused it. Read both keys, learn why a key changes, trust the new one, and watch the session come up.

walkthroughs.title: Watch a rule raise an alarm
walkthroughs.description: Unplug a simulated touch panel from its page, open the system it serves, and watch the official reachability rule open a High alarm that takes the system to degraded while you look.

walkthroughs.title: Write a rule as an expression
walkthroughs.description: Author an event rule's criteria as an expression, see a mistake pointed at by line and column, fix it, preview what the rule would have done over the last day, and save it.
